spotlight.title: Open Ads Manager yourself — the one cause the API cannot see
spotlight.detail: AURA-Life-02__SAC-Fin__4STATE-LPV (120247577690500018) is ACTIVE, all six ads past review, none disapproved, ads_get_errors returns nothing — and it has served zero impressions in ten hours. The watchdog flagged what an API read cannot confirm: ad account 1612966496183765 (Frankie Alicea Ad Account) is UNSETTLED with an unpaid balance, and 2382992452085682 (Life Insurance Ads) is DISABLED for unusual activity. Neither runs this campaign, but an unsettled balance elsewhere on the same business throttles delivery. Log in, open Account Quality + Billing on all three accounts, settle the balance, screenshot what you see.

spotlight.title: Warm the pixel — the fix has been sitting on disk for two days
spotlight.detail: Dataset 1710393736844354 has recorded ~23 PageViews in seven days. Three a day. Special Ad Category (financial services) strips out demographic and interest signal, so that starving pixel is very nearly all Meta has to model against — which is the most likely reason it will not bid. This makes two waiting items one item: sign off the 49-page orayalabs.ai rebuild, deploy it, and turn on Vercel Analytics (w10) plus the Meta pixel on every page. AURA-Life-01 already died of this exact disease on the Lead event; LPV is more forgiving but not immune.

spotlight.title: Six ads are live — is the compliance furniture on them?
spotlight.detail: Passing Meta review is not the same as satisfying Cal Ins Code §1725.5(c). Frankie supplies NPN + CA producer license #; Chitraksh verifies the number, the license and a rates-vary disclaimer actually appear on all six creatives and on the landing page. Do it while spend is $0.00 — this is the cheapest hour this will ever cost, and the last ad account died for precisely the opposite (no license identifiers, a guaranteed-price teaser, all-text PNG).

blockers.label: Zero delivery — 10h live, 0 impressions, $0.00
blockers.detail: Campaign, ad set and all six ads read ACTIVE with no errors; bid strategy Highest volume, AUCTION, CBO $40/day, account 1041909723866642 ACTIVE with a valid payment method. Three candidate causes, in order: starving pixel (~3 PageViews/day under Special Ad Category), edit-after-launch review lag (campaign + ad set edited 04:34 PT, six minutes after creation — worth an hour or two, not ten), and the unsettled/disabled sibling ad accounts. Only the third needs a human in Ads Manager.

blockers.label: Cold pixel — 3 PageViews/day
blockers.detail: The 49-page SEO/AEO rebuild has sat undeployed since Aug 18 and Vercel Analytics (w10) has been open since Aug 5. Deploying the site is now the delivery fix, not a nice-to-have: it is the only lever that feeds the pixel. Lead-event seeding stands at 1 Lead + 1 Schedule in seven days against the 15 needed to switch back to conversion optimization — campaign 120247554618550018 stays parked until then.

blockers.label: Compliance gate 0/7 — now live-fire
blockers.detail: b1–b7 all open. This stopped being theoretical yesterday: b5 (privacy / Do-Not-Sell page) and b7 (CA license # disclosure) bind the creative and the landing page that are running right now, and b4/TCPA binds the moment a lead is dialled.

blockers.label: EIN — 54 days silent
blockers.detail: Re-faxed Jun 28; the eight-business-day window closed Jul 11. Every phone window since Jul 27 has passed unused. Call 1-202-488-3100 in the 8–11 AM PT slot and check RedFax 510-497-1224 in parallel.

tasks.lead: Ads Manager, by hand — settle the unpaid balance
tasks.detail: 1612966496183765 (Frankie Alicea Ad Account) is UNSETTLED. 2382992452085682 (Life Insurance Ads) is DISABLED, flagged for unusual activity, all ads paused. The live campaign runs on 1041909723866642, which is clean — but a delinquent balance on the same business is exactly the kind of throttle that never surfaces through the API. Clear it, then read Account Quality on all three.

tasks.lead: Hand over NPN + CA producer license # today (w13)
tasks.detail: Six creatives are serving-eligible right now. The numbers have to be on them and on the landing page, with a rates-vary disclaimer. This is a five-minute message from you and a blocker for everyone else until it arrives.

tasks.lead: Record the video kit (w9) — 15 days owed
tasks.detail: Still the highest-leverage hour in the company, and now it also feeds the pixel problem: a face creative and a refreshed landing page are what make the site worth landing on. Shirt + tie, iPhone 4K/60fps, ~20–24 min of takes → footage to Chitraksh.

tasks.lead: Write the launch on the record (W15 close-out)
tasks.detail: A watchdog told us the campaign went live, not either founder. One line in the board — went live Aug 19 11:27Z, LPV optimization, $40/day CBO, four states — closes W15 properly and stops the next ten days repeating.

tasks.lead: Cebu ops/supply-chain EA — 2nd conversation (w12)
tasks.detail: Thursday, which is today. 10y ops + supply chain + EA, dealership mutuals read as a green flag. Bucket-warming, not a hire; bring Chitraksh in on the follow-up.

tasks.lead: Mercedes re-pitch reply (w3) — 42 days, the silence is ours
tasks.detail: Their reply is in; we owe the receipts-reply plus an agent demo call. No dealership mail has arrived since — this one is on us.

tasks.lead: Hold the 3-tasks-per-15-hours line (f3)
tasks.detail: Meeting 38’s real decision, and today is the test: a live campaign generates infinite plausible side-quests. Ads Manager, the licence numbers, the EA call. Nothing else gets invented today.

tasks.lead: Ship the SEO site — it is now the delivery fix
tasks.detail: 49 static pages have been on disk since Aug 18 waiting on pricing + integrations sign-off. With the pixel at ~3 PageViews/day and Special Ad Category stripping targeting signal, deploying is the single highest-value engineering act available today. Sign off, deploy, and put the Meta pixel plus Vercel Analytics (w10) on every page in the same push.

tasks.lead: Connect the Meta MCP (w8) — 15 days open
tasks.detail: The watchdog is reading the account from somewhere; this lane still cannot push a creative or pull a report programmatically. With spend live, hand-driving the campaign is how the $600 gets away from us.

tasks.lead: Verify the compliance stamp on all six live creatives
tasks.detail: Meta approved them; California has not. Once Frankie hands over NPN + licence #, confirm both appear on every creative and on the landing page along with a rates-vary disclaimer — and stand up b5 (privacy / Do-Not-Sell) on the page the ads point at.

tasks.lead: Decide the edit-freeze rule before touching the campaign
tasks.detail: Campaign and ad set were both edited 04:34 PT, six minutes after creation — edits re-enter review and reset learning. If you change anything today, change it once, write down what and when, and then leave it alone long enough to read the result.

tasks.lead: PhantomBuster (t3 · W14) — the trial ended, decide cleanly
tasks.detail: Trial ended Aug 19 09:03Z, automations paused platform-side, the misfiring VC phantom is inert without payment. No urgency is forcing repair — which is exactly when to settle the doctrine: Meeting 38 made the VC lane relationship-first, 12–24 months ahead of a raise. Let it lapse on purpose, or pay with a written reason.

tasks.lead: Podcast v2 — the $1,506 economics (w11)
tasks.detail: Frankie has asked twice. It re-baselines the CPL ceiling — and the moment impressions start, a CPL ceiling is the number you will be judging this campaign against. Listen before the first spend day closes.

tasks.lead: W7: keep the win — today the machine ran correctly
tasks.detail: The cofounder sweep fired 00:39:02Z against its 00:38Z cron and this brief 01:07:40Z against 01:06Z, sweep first, 28 minutes apart — the designed order, on cron, for the first time since Aug 5–6. What is still unfixed is the write race: at brief time the sweep had not yet written its log. Stagger the brief ≥45 min after the sweep and the last symptom goes.

tasks.lead: Autoloop unfreeze (w2) — the 2-minute fix, day 54
tasks.detail: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Full Disk Access for the launchd runner. Frozen at cycle 10.

tasks.lead: IRS EIN call rotation (w1) — 54 days
tasks.detail: 1-202-488-3100 in the 8–11 AM PT window (8:30 PM IST); check RedFax 510-497-1224 in parallel. Nothing from the IRS has ever arrived in the swept mailbox.

tasks.lead: Found the launch — W15 answered by evidence
tasks.detail: An FA-ADS watchdog run emailed hanfluxai@gmail.com at 21:21Z last night: AURA-Life-02__SAC-Fin__4STATE-LPV went ACTIVE 04:27 PT / 11:27 UTC Aug 19. Ten days after the Aug 9 target, the launch exists — and the first thing anyone learned about it came from a machine, not a founder. Eight mornings of "T+N unconfirmed" close here.

tasks.lead: Read the zero-delivery diagnosis and ranked the causes
tasks.detail: Clean: bid strategy, buying type, budget, payment method, no errors at any level, six ads past review, frequency 0, spend $0.00 against a $60 kill line. Suspect: pixel 1710393736844354 at ~23 PageViews/7d, the 04:34 PT edit-after-launch, and two sibling ad accounts (one UNSETTLED, one DISABLED). Only the last needs human eyes.

tasks.lead: W7 datum: first clean, on-cron morning since Aug 5–6
tasks.detail: cofounder-worker 00:39:02Z (cron 00:38) then this brief 01:07:40Z (cron 01:06) — correct order, 28-minute stagger, no burst. Residual defect logged honestly: at 01:08Z cofounder_log.json was still stamped Aug 19 10:16Z, so this edition carries yesterday’s digest. Timing recovered; the write race has not.

tasks.lead: Flagged a gap in the watchdog’s own run
tasks.detail: That watchdog session could not read project memory — no project_memory tool exposed, and insurance_ads_division.md / zero_delivery_cold_pixel.md / feedback_legal_gate.md were absent from its disk. It ran on prompt instructions alone, so anything those files encode about cold-pixel handling or the legal gate was not applied. Worth fixing before it makes a call that spends money.

tasks.detail: 8 surgical patches; vm-verified — archive 214→215 cards, 0 duplicate ids, decisions 22, v14 backup md5-intact. Same-day second sweep handled with a suffixed archive id to preserve append-only.
